data.name: General please break through
data.detailed_description:
Game background:

——————

Men break through,

General's patrol.

The political commissar left seven tips and asked him to open them when there was nothing he could do!

Game play:

——————

Collect materials,

Driving a vehicle,

Fight the enemy,

Seize TNT,

Crossing the minefield,

Blast the gates and get out of here!

——————

In the game, you will play "General" first hero; In addition, there is a second actor, who will fight side by side with the general.

In the game, there are necessary materials (first aid kit, food, repair box, etc.) for collection to restore health and physical strength and repair damaged vehicles; There are vehicles (tanks, anti-aircraft vehicles, mountain off-road vehicles, etc.) for the general to drive, which are used for firepower output, plane beating, transportation and defeating the enemy.

This game is bold and innovative. In addition to the hot air balloon, it also adds a mysterious kung fu from the East-Lightness Skill, which can help the general climb over the wall in the battlefield with heavy gunfire, and reach the position that the conventional vehicle can't reach, like nobody's business, bringing a new experience to the general!
